notes: Short: large regional health system looking to unify search across EHR notes, imaging reports, and scanned PDFs. Primary concerns: PHI controls (BAA required), strict access logging (per-user, per-query), and private networking. Want VPC peering or on-prem connector; no public-cloud-only solution unless covered by org-level BAA and explicit data residency. Workload: RAG for clinician assistant + internal QA for coding and billing. Embeddings size target 1536 dims (preference for models with medical tuning). Reranking important to keep false positives low — prefer hybrid ANN -> cross-encoder re-rank but cost sensitivity: target cost per query <$0.02 at 99th percentile. Latency SLO for clinician query: <200ms P50, <400ms P95 for top-k; throughput 150–250 qps during peak. POC constraints: must run on scrubbed data first; production requires BAA and SOC2/ISO evidence. Quotes: "We cannot have PHI leave our VPC without cryptographic controls" — Director of Clinical Informatics. Practical ask: show architecture that supports HSM-backed keys, per-query audit event with user id, and granular retention. Also asked for guidance on index sharding strategy and cold-start costs when rebuilding embeddings.
